capabilities: Chat with LLM providers and self-hosted models in a side panel
Generate responses in the editor from prompts or selected text
Create chatbot profiles with custom personalities and system prompts
Render chatbot replies as Obsidian Markdown, including codeblocks like Dataview
Save, load, and append chat history as markdown notes
extras: Warns that Anthropic models cannot be aborted mid-response and the plugin may need reloading. Also installable via BRAT. Setup instructions for some providers live in external docs linked from the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with large language models or use them to generate note content from prompts and selections.
